Why do fish have GILLS instead of lungs?
AGills look prettier
BFish don't need oxygen
CGills pull oxygen out of WATER. Fish live in water — lungs wouldn't work there.
✅ Correct! Gills are designed for pulling oxygen out of water. Lungs only work with air. The fish's structure matches its environment.
❌ Not quite. Fish absolutely need oxygen — they just get it differently than us. What's special about WHERE fish live?

A bird has a short, thick, cone-shaped beak. Which food is that beak built for?
ANectar deep inside long flowers
BHard seeds that must be cracked open
CFish in shallow water
✅ Correct! A short, thick beak works like a nutcracker. It is strong enough to crack hard seeds, like the ground finches in Darwin's drawing.
❌ Not quite. Long, thin beaks reach nectar, and long, pointed beaks spear fish. What job does a short, thick beak do best?

An eagle has very sharp, hooked CLAWS. What is the function?
AFor decoration
BTo grip and carry prey while flying
CTo help the eagle climb trees
✅ Correct! Eagles catch fish, rabbits, and other animals — often in mid-air or by swooping down. Their sharp hooked talons grab and hold tight. Structure matches function.
❌ Not quite. Eagles don't climb trees much — they fly. And animals don't evolve structures just for decoration. What does an eagle actually DO with its feet?

BSam should have tested rice instead of beans
CTweezers are always slower than spoons

An oak tree has very DEEP ROOTS. Why is this structure important?
ADeep roots anchor a tall tree against wind, and reach water far down in the soil
BDeep roots help the tree walk to new locations
CDeep roots make the tree taller
✅ Correct! An oak tree can grow 80 feet tall. To stand up to wind without falling over, it needs roots that go far down to hold it steady. Roots also reach deep for water.
❌ Not quite. Trees don't walk. And the height of a tree comes from its growing trunk, not its roots. What problem do TALL trees face that short ones don't?

❌ Not quite. Compare the two tools one food at a time. Which tool won with beans? Which won with rice?
